title: IndicSafe: A Benchmark for Evaluating Multilingual LLM Safety in South Asia

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring cross-language safety drift and language-specific refusal bias by evaluating the consistency of LLM safety labels (SAFE, UNSAFE, REFUSAL, AMBIGUOUS) on identical culturally grounded prompts translated across 12 Indic languages and English.
Assessing LLM safety responses and calculating category bias scores using culturally grounded prompts that contain assertions of caste superiority and caste-based discrimination.

Evaluating LLM safety judgments and measuring over- or under-flagging on prompts involving religious hate, derogatory claims about specific religions, and communal provocation in a South Asian context.
Testing model safety behavior and alignment consistency on prompts that assert patriarchal control, promote gendered norms, and exhibit gender discrimination.
Measuring category bias scores and over-censorship (refusal rates) on prompts related to regional political manipulation, political misinformation, and incitement against specific groups.
